name: Brute Malice (Ex)
body:
Prerequisites: Power Attack, Opportunities Aplenty class feature

Benefit(s): When wielding a two-handed weapon or a one-handed martial weapon in two hands, the bonus damage from opportunities aplenty increases to +3 per two levels, instead of +2 per two levels.
